lesson_description: In this lesson, we will delve into the basics of Python and Django. We will cover what Django is, its usefulness, and how to install and set up a Django environment. We will then write our first Django project and explore the basic structure of a Django application, laying the groundwork for more advanced topics.

subtopics.title: Setting Up the Django Environment
subtopics.description: Learn how to install Python and Django, and set up a development environment. Understand the importance of a clean environment for consistent project development.

subtopics.title: Writing Your First Django Project
subtopics.description: Create a simple Django project from scratch. Explore the basic structure of a Django application, including the project structure, settings, and basic views. Understand the importance of a well-structured project for future scalability and maintenance.
